name: moodboard.suggest
description: Shows the person moodboard posts you pick, by key from moodboard.list, on a card, for an idea or for a new one. It saves nothing: the person changes the picks and confirms on the card. Never call idea.edit for the same picks.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('idea', (select jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'hook', i.hook, 'inspiration', i.inspiration) from brandbase.ideas i where i.id = :idea and i.brand_id = :brand), 'picks', :picks::jsonb) as result
